description: False positive pattern — CPU spike from scheduled batch job, not a real anomaly
evidence_text: Alert: HighCPUUsage on pod data-pipeline-batch-7d4b9 in namespace multi-agent. CPU at 85% for 10 minutes. z_cpu=3.2 (slight sigma breach). However: kubectl describe shows this is a CronJob pod named 'data-pipeline-batch' that runs every day at 02:00 UTC. Current time is 02:08 UTC. Previous 7 CronJob runs all show identical CPU pattern at the same time. No errors in pod logs. No 5xx from any downstream services. Memory is stable at 40% of limit. Other pods in namespace are healthy. The CronJob is a scheduled ETL batch_job that processes 500K records daily — CPU spike is expected behavior.
